messages:
Anya L: Quick thread: we need to finalize IA changes for the console nav before next sprint. Main concerns: shallow left nav groups, canonical deep links for shareable dashboards, and breadcrumb microcopy. I sketched a flow where zones become top-level nav nodes and subpages are nested tabs. Link: https://figma.com/s/console-ia-v2

Tom H: From infra POV we should treat top-level zones as part of the path: `/p/:id/zone/:zoneSlug/*`. Tabs under a zone can map to nested paths: `/p/123/zone/registry/models` so server-side routing (SSG/SSR) can index if needed.

Maria P: Accessibility checklist: when navigating to `/p/123/zone/registry/models` we must programmatically set focus to the main H1, announce the zone change with a polite live region, and ensure `aria-current` is on the active nav item. Also ensure the breadcrumb uses landmarks for screen readers.

Jiro K: Tech tradeoff: if we go path-first, legacy deep-links that used fragments will break unless we normalize. Proposal: detect legacy `#zone=` on load and run `history.replaceState` to canonical path. Emit telemetry event `nav.normalized` with `from:hash` to monitor.

Sam R: Microcopy suggestion: breadcrumb label for registry should be "Model Registry" in full crumbs but display as "Registry" in compact breadcrumbs (ellipsis on small screens). We should keep crumb segments URL-safe: lowercase, hyphenated.

Ken F: Mobile nav: collapsible left nav on mobile should not be part of canonical URL. Collapse state saved in sessionStorage only; deep links always open expanded to the requested zone to avoid confusion.

aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: add `role=\"navigation\" aria-label=\"Primary console navigation\"` and ensure skip link target `#main-content` is present.

Tom H: Edge-case: history back/forward after `replaceState` can make the back button no-op for users who expect old hash to exist. Plan: do soft-rewrite only if `from` is a supported legacy pattern and increment user-visible stack with `pushState` in fallback. We'll add tests.

Maria P: Keyboard nav details: when zone header is focused and user presses Enter, it should activate and move focus to first tabbable control in the main content. When toggling collapsed groups, use `aria-expanded` and update sr-only text to indicate new state.

Anya L: Breadcrumb behavior: root crumb text should be 'Projects' (not Workspace). Next crumb = project name. Third crumb = zone (Model Registry). Last crumb = active page or tab (e.g., 'Models', 'Versions'). On very long chains show `Projects / … / Registry / Versions` using an accessible menu for the collapsed middle crumbs.

Sam R: For deep-links to specific resource (e.g., model details) use `/p/:id/zone/registry/models/:modelId`. We'll support optional query params for UI state like `?fullscreen=true` but avoid persisting ephemeral UI (collapse, filters) in canonical links.

Jiro K: Implementation checklist: 1) router change to `/zone/:zoneSlug/*`; 2) parser for legacy `?zone=` and `#zone=`; 3) normalization with telemetry; 4) unit + e2e for focus + history; 5) sessionStorage for collapse. I'll draft PR.

Ken F: Analytics: agree to dedupe events by normalizing to canonical path before emitting page view. If we detect a legacy link, emit both `legacy_link_click` and `pageview_canonical` for reconciliation.

Anya L: Tiny copy decisions: left nav group header 'Workflows' vs 'Jobs' — team prefers 'Workflows'. Also add a visual divider between zones and subtle grouping label (no clickable affordance).

Maria P: Accessibility follow-up: ensure contrast for divider is >= 3:1 when used as an interactive boundary and 2:1 ok for purely decorative. Give the nav-group headers a 4px focus outline token that matches global tokens.

Sam R: I'll open a product ticket with acceptance criteria + rollout plan (gradual rollout with 10% normalization telemetry first).

Anya L: Action items recap: Anya update Figma with microcopy and responsive crumb behavior; Jiro implement parser + normalization; Tom coordinate backend route support; Maria add a11y checklist & verify; Ken add analytics plan; Sam file product rollout ticket. Thanks all — will follow up with updated screens and the canonical URL spec here. :shipit:
